# Debug the escaped char issue
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', '''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import render_inner_html, run_postprocessors, striptags
import xml.etree.ElementTree as etree

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc"])
md_text = r"# escaped\\_character"

print("Input:", repr(md_text))

md.convert(md_text)

for el in md.parser.root.iter():
    if el.tag == 'h1':
        print(f"h1 text: {repr(el.text)}")
        inner = render_inner_html(md, el)
        print(f"render_inner_html: {repr(inner)}")
        
        processed = run_postprocessors(md, inner)
        print(f"after postprocessors: {repr(processed)}")
        
        stripped = striptags(processed)
        print(f"after striptags: {repr(stripped)}")
        
        from html import unescape
        unescaped = unescape(stripped)
        print(f"after html.unescape: {repr(unescaped)}")
        break
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-500:])
